## `client.registry`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.site.RegistryManager`.

Configuration registry (`@registry`).

### `client.registry.get`

Value of a registry record.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.site.RegistryManager.get`.

Calls `GET /@registry/plone.site_title` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/registry.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.registry.get("plone.site_title")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client registry get plone.site_title
```

```text
"Welcome to Plone 6"
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@registry/plone.site_title HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@registry/plone.site_title -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
"Welcome to Plone 6"
```

### `client.registry.list`

Registry records.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.site.RegistryManager.list`.

### `client.system.email_send`

Send an email through the site (`@email-send`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.site.SystemManager.email_send`.

Calls `POST /@email-send` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/email-send.html)).

```{note}
This example was not run against a site, because the site needs a mail server.
The request below was built, and not sent.
```

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.system.email_send(
    "editor@example.org",
    "site@example.org",
    "The report is ready.",
    subject="Report",
)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/@email-send HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "to": "editor@example.org",
  "from": "site@example.org",
  "message": "The report is ready.",
  "subject": "Report"
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@email-send -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"to":"editor@example.org","from":"site@example.org","message":"The report is ready.","subject":"Report"}'
```
````
`````
